direct_support_design.model_requirements: M03 low base may use three deck ribs and two open top fork lanes, preserving outer/support/usable bounds. Actual M/P triangles must prove fork clearance and contacts; reference broad deck is not solid geometry authority.
direct_support_design.pickup_rule: Fixed support/buffer must leave actual open fork approach channels below HU support plane. Solid full deck or ground-resting solid HU without fork access rejects transfer.
direct_support_design.slot_bottom_rule: HU bottom remains exact C04 supportY; no extra carrier silently inserted underneath stored HU.

fork_design.L05_extension: Historical .30m fork top collides with front tyres. All travel forks are high(.70/.75), unchanged heel.40/tip1.50. Low handling extends a real carriage+.40 only while stopped; its enlarged footprint needs actual M14.8 action proof and never enters travel edges.

geometry_profile_extensions.authority: C08v0.2 vertical operating extension, unchanged accepted source files.
geometry_profile_extensions.proof: Same per-component XZ bounds as L05/L07/L09, nonnegativeY and maxwholeheight2.10 unchanged. L07/L09/L11 ground-obstacle swept polygons, continuous yaw inflation, clear widths and maximum-height proofs are unchanged; this is NOT old3D component containment. M/P physical collision proof is separate.

long_cradle_design.positive_lock: Two retained rear pins/ears plus independent visible load restraint; missing lock or restraint rejects.
long_cradle_design.support_approval: Synthetic rigid restrained bundle with fixed symmetric CoG; no general beam stress certification.
long_cradle_design.transfer_interface: Actual M04/M14 must provide arm/pad/pocket relief and verify lower rack plane .25m before any transfer. No continuous deck through cradle pads; upper12 LONG addresses stay blocked.

rating_design.frozen_selection: Replaces v0.1 600kgm before stock/optimization: extended654kg IBC at1.0m needs explicit larger declared design. Same rating in both A/B cases; not a measured improvement.
rating_design.meaning: Declared simulation equipment rating, not calculated structural stability or a real manufacturer's capacity plate.
rating_design.reach_rule: Reach shifts load AND fork heel forward. Physical fork load-centre is unchanged, but moment arm about fixed chassis reference increases by .40m; capacity must use that increased arm.

route_policy.action_evidence_requirement: Matching actual M/P mesh hashes and contact/lock/support proofs; a design verdict alone cannot start an operation.

analytic_pose_rule.arc_samples: 5degree display/reference samples are not linear interpolation instructions; verification uses<=0.5degree steps plus inter-sample displacement inflation.
analytic_pose_rule.rear_steer_arc: yaw(u)=lerp(start_yaw,end_yaw,u); F=ICR+[-q*cos(yaw),q*sin(yaw)] where q=icr_vehicle_local_x; root=F-.4*[sin(yaw),cos(yaw)]. Exact analytic curves, not chords between samples.
analytic_pose_rule.rear_steering: For positive yaw curvature, virtual rear steer is negative. Reverse edges retain physical steering angle while motion/yaw traversal reverse.
analytic_pose_rule.root: Root XYZ is floor centre, as L05. Front axle lies .4m along local+Z.

route_policy.conservative_policy: Never admit cargo onto bare-only edges even if its projected AABB fits.
route_policy.reservations: Existing L12 traffic groups and actual pair/operator availability must be held by source scheduler.

stopped_reach_handling_design.mechanism: Connected twin mast/side reach guides and carriage. Low side guides outside front tyres; rear crossplate behind tyres and front plate ahead when low; actual model must prove all intermediate poses.
stopped_reach_handling_design.release_sequence: After setdown, reverse withdraw with carriage extended; lift empty forks before full retraction.
stopped_reach_handling_design.required_actual_proof: M14.8 continuous actual fork/carriage/tyre/HU/rack/traffic contacts and state timestamps, plus exclusive operator/vehicle/action space. A declared sequence is not an implemented action.
